candidates.source_name: ЕСЈН — Електронски систем за јавни набавки (Electronic Public Procurement System)
candidates.why_relevant: Single mandatory national portal where every contracting authority (Ministry of Finance, Treasury, NBRSM, UJP, Customs, Health Fund, state-owned entities, municipalities) publishes annual procurement plans, contract notices (огласи), tender documentation, award decisions and realised contracts. Payment/card/ATM/POS/core-banking/compliance tenders in MK surface here first, usually with the regulatory driver and the delivery deadline stated in the tender documentation.
candidates.access_status: public, free; some modules require registration as economic operator for full tender documentation
candidates.legal_status: official government publication; public-access module explicitly designed for public inspection
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled scrape of the PublicAccess ASP.NET modules (Notifications / Annual Plans / Awarded Contracts / Realised Contracts) — the site exposes JSON-ish .asmx service endpoints under /services/ and dossier URLs of the form /PublicAccess/Dossie/dosieNotificationForACPP.aspx?Id=<UUID>&Level=<n>; grid data can also be exported to CSV. Requires a real browser UA / session handling (direct WebFetch returned 403). Keyword filter on CPV codes and MK terms.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language web search on 'е-набавки ... огласи' plus snowball from Ministry of Finance e-javni-nabavki page
queries_used: е-набавки Електронски систем за јавни набавки Македонија огласи
"e-nabavki.gov.mk" оглас PublicAccess Dosie notice URL структура барање
candidates.observed_blocker: Plain WebFetch of https://e-nabavki.gov.mk/PublicAccess/home.aspx returned HTTP 403 Forbidden — hypothesis: bot-defended but live (the portal is referenced as active by finance.gov.mk and vlada.mk). Not to be recorded as dead.

candidates.source_name: Биро за јавни набавки (Bureau for Public Procurement, BJN) — Огласи and institutional site
candidates.why_relevant: The BJN is the regulator/operator of the procurement system inside the Ministry of Finance. Its site carries the notices feed, the legal framework (Закон за јавните набавки), handbooks, an interactive open-data search platform over all institutions' procurement, and annual reports on the state of the procurement system — the best pointer layer for discovering contracting authorities and rule changes that shape how banking/payments tenders are framed.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of /oglasi/ and the news/annual-report sections; harvest linked PDFs; use as seed list for contracting authorities
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search for the Bureau; snowball from finance.gov.mk ministry structure page
queries_used: Биро за јавни набавки Македонија bjn.gov.mk

candidates.source_name: Министерство за финансии — Е-јавни набавки / Јавни набавки section
candidates.why_relevant: The Ministry of Finance is both the policy owner for payments/financial-sector legislation and a major contracting authority (Treasury/Трезор systems, PFM reform IT, tax and customs adjacent systems). Its own procurement pages carry MoF-run tenders and mirror IFI-funded national-market notices.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the mk-MK and en-US procurement subtrees weekly; also monitor sibling pages for the Treasury (Трезор) and Public Revenue/Customs policy directorates
candidates.discovered_via_method: search + snowball
queries_used: е-набавки Електронски систем за јавни набавки Македонија огласи
Биро за јавни набавки Македонија bjn.gov.mk

candidates.source_name: CFCD — Central Financing and Contracting Department, Ministry of Finance (IPA contracting authority) — Tenders
candidates.why_relevant: Sole contracting authority for EU IPA-funded projects in North Macedonia — the channel through which donor-funded regulator/supervisor modernisation (PFM, tax, customs, financial supervision IT, AML/compliance systems) is tendered. Notices state the EU-accession-driven requirement and the implementation deadline.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the tenders API/listing at /tenders/publicTender/... (detail pages use numeric IDs, e.g. /tenders/publicTender/detailedTender/302?tab=latestPublications) daily-to-weekly; also mirror the legacy archive site
candidates.discovered_via_method: English search on IPA contracting; snowball from Ministry of Finance
queries_used: CFCD Central Financing and Contracting Department North Macedonia tenders cfcd.finance.gov.mk IPA

candidates.source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (EU Official Journal supplement), North Macedonia notices
candidates.why_relevant: Above-threshold MK notices and EU/IPA-funded notices with North Macedonia as place of performance are published in TED. TED is fully machine-readable (search API + bulk XML/notice packages) and is the cleanest structured feed for cross-border payment/card/core-banking/compliance procurement touching MK.
candidates.source_subtype: supranational tender gazette with open API
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the TED Search API with expert queries filtering country=MK (and place-of-performance MK) plus CPV codes for banking/payment/IT systems (30123400-series ATM/cash machines, 48xxxxxx software, 66xxxxxx financial services, 72xxxxxx IT services); ingest notice XML/PDF
candidates.discovered_via_method: English search on TED + North Macedonia
queries_used: TED tender North Macedonia payment system central bank procurement notice

candidates.source_name: EBRD Client eProcurement Portal (ECEPP) — North Macedonia notices
candidates.why_relevant: EBRD-financed projects in MK (municipal, energy, financial-institution and public-sector modernisation) tender through ECEPP; IFI notices capture donor-funded systems work that never appears on the national portal, and PIU/consultant notices signal projects 12-24 months before implementation tenders.
candidates.access_status: public listing; full documents require ECEPP registration
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the notice search filtered on country=North Macedonia; individual notices resolve as viewNotice.html?displayNoticeId=<id>; complement with the EBRD procurement-notices page on ebrd.com
candidates.discovered_via_method: English search on EBRD procurement + North Macedonia

candidates.source_name: World Bank project procurement — P176366 'Building Effective, Transparent and Accountable PFM Institutions' (North Macedonia) procurement plans & STEP notices
candidates.why_relevant: The Ministry of Finance-implemented PFM project explicitly covers Macro-Economy & Public Finance and ICT/Telecommunications; its published procurement plan enumerates forthcoming goods/consultancy packages (treasury, tax, PFM IT) with methods, estimated values and dates — an early-warning list of upcoming state financial-systems tenders. National-market packages are cross-published on ESJN and the MoF site.
candidates.legal_status: official IFI publication, open documents policy
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the World Bank Documents & Reports API for projectid=P176366 and doctype 'Procurement Plan'; also poll the World Bank Procurement Notice dataset in the Data Catalog and UN Development Business for GPN/SPNs
candidates.discovered_via_method: English search on World Bank MK PFM project

candidates.source_name: Државна комисија за жалби по јавни набавки (State Appeals Commission for Public Procurement, DKZJN)
candidates.why_relevant: Publishes filed complaints daily and decisions from its sessions. Appeals against payment/card/ATM/core-banking tenders reveal specification disputes, which vendors bid, and whether award timelines (and therefore compliance deadlines) slip — information not visible in the notice itself.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the complaints and decisions listings (files served under /sites/default/files/...), OCR/parse the PDF decisions, join on the ESJN notice number to enrich tender records; note a parallel/mirror domain dkzjn.mk exists

negative_findings.description: Direct WebFetch of the ESJN public-access homepage (https://e-nabavki.gov.mk/PublicAccess/home.aspx) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.
negative_findings.result_summary: No page content retrieved. Multiple independent official pages (finance.gov.mk, vlada.mk, bjn.gov.mk) reference the portal as the live, mandatory national system, so this is treated as bot-defence, not a dead source. Status: unverified, hypothesis = live but bot-defended.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most important source in this cell will need a browser-grade fetcher (real UA, cookies, possibly ViewState handling) or the documented .asmx/service endpoints rather than a naive HTTP client.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated public 'јавни набавки' landing page for the National Bank (NBRSM) was located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language searches combining Народна банка + јавни набавки returned only institutional pages (за НБРСМ, конкурси, контакт) and the text of the Public Procurement Law hosted on nbrm.mk — not a procurement notice list.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Central-bank payment-system tenders are the highest-value signal in this cell; if NBRSM has no own-site listing, collection must go through ESJN filtered by contracting authority, which makes the ESJN collector a single point of failure.

negative_findings.description: No specific live or recent MK tender for ATM/POS/card/core-banking systems was surfaced by search in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language queries on банкомати / ПОС терминали / платен систем + тендер returned the ESJN portal, the Public Procurement Law and unrelated commercial POS pages, but no concrete notice. This reflects search-engine coverage of the ASP.NET portal, not absence of such tenders.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that keyword discovery via general web search is not viable for this cell — the collector must query ESJN/TED directly by CPV code and contracting authority, not rely on search engines.

negative_findings.description: Numerous commercial tender aggregators (tenderinfo.org, tenderdetail.com, globaltenders.com, tenderimpulse.com, tendersontime.com, gtbc.net, developmentaid.org) claim North Macedonia coverage.
negative_findings.result_summary: These were seen in results but not adopted as candidates: they are paywalled, of unverified completeness, republish official data, and their terms typically forbid systematic reuse.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Tempting shortcuts that would introduce licensing risk and unverifiable provenance into a source register whose value depends on primary-source traceability. DevelopmentAid is the least objectionable for IFI forecast notices but still paywalled.

negative_findings.description: Службен весник на РСМ (Official Gazette) as a secondary publication channel for procurement notices was noted but not directly assessed.
negative_findings.result_summary: The Public Procurement Law text indicates notices may be published in ЕСЈН and/or the Official Gazette, with above-threshold notices also in the EU Official Journal. The Gazette's own portal was not fetched in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The Gazette is the authoritative legal record and the place where the regulatory obligation behind a tender is actually promulgated; it should be scouted as a companion source in a later pass.

coverage_gaps.description: State-owned and para-state entities that are heavy payments/cash consumers were not individually scouted: Македонска пошта (postal payments/counters), Фонд за ПИОМ (pension payouts), Агенција за вработување, ЕВН/state utilities, Централен регистар, and municipal treasuries.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a second pass enumerating contracting authorities from the ESJN institution grid and the uslugi.gov.mk register, then score each for payments/card/ATM/POS relevance rather than scouting them ad hoc.

coverage_gaps.description: No CPV code list was fixed for this cell, so neither the TED nor the ESJN collector has a precise filter yet.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Define the CPV set (e.g. 30123400 cash dispensers/ATMs, 30144200 ticket/card machines, 30162000 smart cards, 48xxxxxx banking/financial software, 66xxxxxx financial services, 72xxxxxx IT services, 79xxxxxx audit/compliance) and validate it against a sample of historical MK awards before productionising.

coverage_gaps.description: IFI coverage is partial: EBRD, World Bank and EU/IPA were scouted, but EIB, Council of Europe Development Bank, UNDP/UNOPS MK procurement, KfW, USAID successors and Swiss SECO channels were not.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout UNDP/UNOPS MK country procurement pages and the EIB/CEB notice feeds in a follow-up pass; UNOPS in particular was flagged as funding large MK projects.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language (sq) procurement publication was not searched at all; MK publishes some official content bilingually.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add sq glossary terms (prokurim publik, njoftim për kontratë, tender) and re-run discovery over the same portals, plus municipal authorities in Albanian-majority municipalities.

coverage_gaps.description: Several candidate URLs are inferred entry points (TED search page, ECEPP notice list, dkzjn.gov.mk root, data.gov.mk dataset filters) rather than pages fetched and confirmed in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Let the deterministic liveness pass resolve these; where a root resolves but the deep listing path differs, re-derive the listing URL from the live site's own navigation rather than guessing.

brief: North Macedonia's public-procurement intelligence for banking and payments is heavily centralised: ЕСЈН (e-nabavki.gov.mk), operated by the Биро за јавни набавки inside the Ministry of Finance, is the mandatory publication point for annual plans, notices, awards and realised contracts across every contracting authority, and it is the one source this cell cannot do without — though it is bot-defended (403 on plain fetch) and best reached through its .asmx service endpoints and dossier UUID URLs, with data.gov.mk and the skopjehacklab civic-tech scraper as machine-readable auxiliaries. The donor layer runs in parallel and is easier to collect: CFCD contracts all EU/IPA money, TED carries above-threshold and EU-funded MK notices with a clean API, and EBRD ECEPP plus World Bank project procurement plans (notably P176366 PFM, Ministry of Finance-implemented) pre-announce regulator and treasury modernisation 12-24 months ahead. Around these sit high-value enrichment sources — the Државна комисија за жалби по јавни набавки for award disputes and slipped timelines, the Државен завод за ревизија for what was actually delivered, and own-site document stores at Царинска управа, УЈП and ФЗО that publish full technical specifications as PDFs. The main open risks are the absence of a discoverable NBRSM procurement listing (forcing central-bank coverage through ESJN alone), an undefined CPV filter set, and no Albanian-language pass.
